title: Green Spinach, White Bean & Rice Pot
description: A warm, filling rice pot with creamy white beans, spinach, and peas.

steps.text: Simmer rice and beans in seasoned broth.
Stir in spinach and peas near the end.

cookSteps.text: Add {{rice}} rice, {{beans}} white beans, {{broth}} broth, and {{garlic}} garlic powder to a large pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes.
Stir in {{spinach}} spinach and {{peas}} peas. Cover and cook 5–7 minutes more, until rice is tender and vegetables are hot.
Remove from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Green Broccoli & Cheddar Lentil Pot
description: Tender lentils and broccoli finished with a little cheddar for a cozy green one-pot supper.

ingredients.item: dry brown or green lentils, rinsed

steps.text: Stir in cheddar off the heat.

cookSteps.text: Add {{lentils}} lentils, {{broth}} broth, and {{garlic}} garlic powder to a pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover loosely, and simmer until lentils are nearly tender, about 25 minutes.
Stir in {{broccoli}} broccoli and simmer until tender, about 7 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in {{cheese}} cheddar until melted. Season to taste.

title: Red Tomato & Lentil Pasta Pot
description: A hearty tomato-red lentil pasta cooked together in one pot for an easy red dinner.

steps.text: Simmer lentils in tomato and broth.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Stir in red peppers if desired.

cookSteps.text: Add {{lentils}} red lentils, {{tomatoes}} crushed tomatoes, {{broth}} broth, and {{seasoning}} Italian seasoning to a large pot.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in {{pasta}} pasta and cook uncovered, stirring often, until pasta and lentils are tender, about 10–12 minutes. Add a splash of water if needed.
If using, stir in {{peppers}} roasted red peppers and heat for 2 minutes. Season to taste.

title: Red Tomato, Bean & Rice Pot
description: Tomatoes, kidney beans, and rice make an inexpensive, filling red one-pot meal.

steps.text: Combine rice, beans, tomatoes, broth, and seasoning.
Cover and simmer until rice is tender.

cookSteps.text: Add {{rice}} rice, {{beans}} kidney beans, {{tomatoes}} diced tomatoes, {{broth}} broth, {{paprika}} paprika, and {{garlic}} garlic powder to a large pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender, about 18–20 minutes.
Remove from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes. Fluff and season to taste.

title: Creamy Potato & White Bean Chowder
description: A thick, comforting potato and white bean chowder made with inexpensive pantry basics.

steps.text: Cook potatoes and beans in broth.
Add milk and corn and warm gently.

cookSteps.text: Add {{potatoes}} potatoes, {{beans}} white beans, {{broth}} broth, and {{garlic}} garlic powder to a large pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer until potatoes are very tender, about 20 minutes.
Mash some of the potatoes and beans against the side of the pot to thicken the chowder.
Stir in {{milk}} milk and {{corn}} corn. Heat gently for 5–7 minutes without boiling hard. Season to taste.

title: Creamy Cauliflower, Chickpea & Rice Pot
description: Tender cauliflower, chickpeas, and rice simmer together into a mild, filling cream-colored supper.

steps.text: Cook rice, chickpeas, and cauliflower in broth.
Finish with milk for a creamy texture.

cookSteps.text: Add {{rice}} rice, {{chickpeas}} chickpeas, {{cauliflower}} cauliflower, {{broth}} broth, and {{garlic}} garlic powder to a large pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until rice and cauliflower are tender, about 18–20 minutes.
Stir in {{milk}} milk and warm gently for 3 minutes. Season to taste.
Remove from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes before serving.
